title: AR Showcase
intro: Try nine destinations in this AR demo, wherever you are. In the app, destination AR is only available when you visit the actual location.
openHint: Open this destination in the AR Showcase
readyHint: This demo skips location checks. Outside the showcase, you must visit the destination to open AR. After starting, move your phone slowly to place the experience around you.
preflight: Use a well-lit space with room to turn. Camera access is needed to show the experience around you.
loadFailed: This destination could not be loaded. Try again, or choose another destination.
unavailable: Open the showcase from Profile or Settings after signing in or continuing as a guest.
passportHint: Start AR to collect a demo stamp. These stamps stay in this showcase and reset when you leave.
expired: This AR session has ended. Choose the destination again to start a new experience.
